proposed_by: fixture: hand-written stand-in for model output (no model was called)

hypotheses.description: A product cannot be created with a negative price; a price of zero is allowed.
hypotheses.probe:
import pytest

from shopcart import Product


def test_negative_price_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Product("X", "X", "-0.01", "misc")


def test_zero_price_is_allowed():
    assert Product("X", "X", "0", "misc").price == 0

hypotheses.description: Money values must be finite: NaN and Infinity are rejected with ValueError.
Discount codes are case-sensitive and stored exactly as configured.
A cart line cannot hold more than 999 units of a product.
hypotheses.probe:
import pytest

from shopcart import Cart, InvalidQuantityError, Product


def test_quantity_above_limit_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(InvalidQuantityError):
        Cart().add(Product("X", "X", "1", "misc"), 1000)

hypotheses.description: Adding a product checks available stock.
Every error the library defines derives from CartError.
hypotheses.probe:
from shopcart import CartError, InvalidDiscountError, InvalidQuantityError


def test_errors_share_a_base_class():
    assert issubclass(InvalidQuantityError, CartError)
    assert issubclass(InvalidDiscountError, CartError)

hypotheses.description: A cart total is never negative, whatever discount is applied.
